binding_findings: API integration is permitted subject to the agreement, applicable law, third-party rights, account controls, fees, and current OpenAI policies.
Employment high-stakes decisions require human review; AIGC may assist but may not autonomously decide employment outcomes.
The adapter uses Responses API text generation only, defines no provider tools, and sets store=false.
store=false does not prove zero retention; abuse-monitoring and prompt-cache retention remain account and endpoint dependent.
API keys may not be transferred; AIGC requires a project-bound secret-broker identity before live use.
Generated output requires human evaluation and cannot substitute for regulatory, legal, or professional obligations.
Employment decisions with material detrimental impact require human supervision.
Safety filters and provider safeguards may not be bypassed or silently disabled.
Data retention depends on the selected service, model, account configuration, abuse monitoring, grounding, and caching features.
The adapter uses project- and region-bound Vertex AI ADC, text generation only, and an empty provider-tool list.

mandatory_revalidation: when a provider policy effective date changes
when model, modality, tool, retention, geography, or employment-decision scope changes
